narrative.overview: Family Finances is a calm, private book of record with a friendlier skin: soft pastels, fully rounded edges, and a colour per kind of money. Still a product surface for a 30-second check-in (one honest number, accounts, density behind a tap), but each account type now carries a gentle pastel identity, gains read green and drops red, and every surface is generously rounded (pill buttons, 20px cards). Colour is soft and functional: pastel backgrounds with a darker AA-legible ink on top. Blue #2563eb is reserved for actions (press/navigate), distinct from the identity palette. Pastel-not-neon and rounded keep it clear of gamified/confetti fintech and crypto/trading neon.
keyCharacteristics: One honest number first; density behind a tap.
A pastel colour per account type on the circle and its forecast line.
Green for gains, red for drops, always with a up/down glyph (not colour-only).
Everything rounded: pill buttons, 20px cards, 14px fields, 24px sheets, round avatars.
Blue #2563eb = actions only, distinct from the identity palette.
Mobile-first, capped at a 430px column that centres on desktop.

rules.name: The Identity-vs-Action Rule
rules.body: Pastel palette identifies (which account/line); blue acts (what you press). Never use a type pastel for a button or blue as an account identity.

rules.name: The Pastel-not-Neon Rule
rules.body: Colour lives in soft pastel backgrounds with AA-legible ink on top. No saturated fills behind text, no glow, no gradient.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case at weight 600 - never uppercase, never tracked eyebrows.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling
rules.body: 700 is the heaviest weight (headers only); no 800/900.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: Reach for a hairline or whitespace before a shadow. A surface that isn't floating has no shadow.

dos: Do lead each screen with one honest number, then a hairline-separated list.
Do give each account type its pastel identity (bg) + AA-legible ink (initial, line).
Do use green #047857 for gains and red #dc2626 for drops, always with a up/down glyph.
Do keep blue #2563eb for actions/active/focus only - distinct from the identity palette.
Do round generously: pill buttons, 20px cards, 14px fields, 24px sheets, round avatars.
Do keep icons monochrome filled SVG, >=44px tap targets, honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do fold density (month-by-month, full lists, per-account lines) behind a tap/toggle.
donts: Don't slide into gamified/confetti fintech - no mascots, streaks, badges, saturated fills, gradients, or emoji-as-icon.
Don't drift toward crypto/trading neon - no neon-on-black, tickers, pervasive high-saturation red/green, dark-by-default.
Don't rebuild the cluttered high-street bank dashboard - no tile soup, upsells, notification badges.
Don't blur the two colour languages: no type-pastel on a button, no action-blue as an account identity.
Don't put saturated colour behind text, add glows/gradients, or use border-left/right >1px as a coloured stripe.
Don't exceed weight 700 or use uppercase tracked eyebrows.
